name: gotcha-english
description: Support English learning with independent skills for diary feedback, Notion learning-space setup, and evidence-based learning-issue collection.

interface.shortDescription: 通过不同 Skills 辅助英语学习
interface.longDescription: Gotcha English 提供可独立使用的英语 Skills。Diary Coach 逐段批改英语日记，解释修改并保留原意与表达风格。Setup Learning Space 通过已连接的 Notion 工具建立学习空间，或为已有问题库补充缺少的字段。Collect Learning Issues 从指定范围的英语对话收录学习问题，归并来源证据、检查重复并保留原有内容。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $diary-coach to review my English diary paragraph by paragraph.
